CFML Language Reference: Functions

Sgn

Returns 1 if the number is positive, -1 if it is negative and 0 if it is zero.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

Sgn(number)

Parameters

number
Any number.

Returns

-1, 0 or 1.

Usage

Together with Abs you can take a number apart and put it back together: n equals Sgn(n) * Abs(n).

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Balances = "250.00,0,-75.50">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Balance</TH><TH>Sgn</TH><TH>Status</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="b" LIST="#Balances#">
<CFSET Status = ListGetAt("Overdrawn,Even,In credit", Sgn(b) + 2)>
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#DollarFormat(b)#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#Sgn(b)#</TD><TD>#Status#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
